evaluation_plan.checkpoint_rule: best.pt selected by validation mAP50-95 recorded in completed training_summary.json
evaluation_plan.calibration_rule: 480 calibration frames; max F1 and max recall subject to frame FPR<=10%; tie lower FPR then larger threshold
evaluation_plan.sampled_test_rule: all 792 fixed 24-per-video frames; mAP and presence
evaluation_plan.continuous_test_rule: all original frames in all 33 test videos; presence only
evaluation_plan.demo_rule: all frames, four category lexicographic-first test videos selected before model test inference
limitations: video-disjoint, not session-disjoint: official XLSX lacks session/date field
one training seed and one architecture; no statistical seed uncertainty
continuous presence is not full-video bounding-box mAP
calibration FPR is empirical and not a test guarantee

frozen_choices.scope_statement: Only YOLO11n seed0 was trained/evaluated; no YOLO11s or additional seeds.

result.scope: single YOLO11n seed0; no multiseed or YOLO11s
